title: Mail/Event Protocol Foundation
description:
Introduce minimal inter-agent messaging for coordination events.

## Goals
- Structured events for orchestration coordination
- Foundation for future Gas Town-style mail protocol

## Implementation
- Define Mail types in src/types/mail.ts:
  - { id, from, to, type, payload, createdAt }
- Persist mail in OyarsaState or JSON log per field
- Start with minimal event types:
  - TASK_COMPLETED, TASK_FAILED, REVIEW_COMPLETED
- Oyarsa emits mail events when:
  - Eldil completes/crashes on a task
  - Sorn review finishes
- TUI can display basic 'Events' panel later

## Reference
Gas Town mail protocol: POLECAT_DONE, MERGE_READY, HELP, etc.

## Effort: 1-2 days (lower priority)

title: Molecules/MEOW Workflow System
description:
Layer multi-step workflow abstractions on top of Beads.

## Goals
- Support persistent, resumable multi-step workflows
- Crash recovery: workflows survive restarts
- Template-based workflow definitions

## Implementation
- Define Molecule model:
  - id, formulaId, steps[], currentStep, status
- Storage: .perelandra-state.json or per-field file
- Map each step to Beads tasks (via labels or parent/child)
- Extend Oyarsa:
  - When step completes (via event), advance currentStep
  - Create/claim next Beads task
  - On startup, resume partially completed molecules

## Reference
Gas Town MEOW: formula -> protomolecule -> molecule (ice-9 -> solid -> liquid)

## Effort: 2+ days (Phase 2+)

Minimal Hook-Style Task Scheduler
description:
Implement a simple Oyarsa tick() scheduler for Beads tasks.

## Goals
- Automatic task assignment to available workers
- Respect concurrency limits per field
- Avoid double-claiming tasks

## Implementation
- Oyarsa.tick():
  1. List 'ready' Beads tasks via BeadsManager.listReady()
  2. For each field/Hnau, if under maxWorkersPerField, spawn Eldil
  3. Mark claimed tasks with label or metadata
- CLI: 'perelandra tick' command for manual trigger
- Optional: Background interval inside Oyarsa (configurable)

## Reference
Gas Town hook-based propulsion: agents wake, check hook, execute immediately.
This is a simplified centralized version.

## Effort: 1-2 days

Lightweight Witness - Stuck Detection
description:
Add background monitoring for stuck workers and unhealthy services.

## Goals
- Detect and handle stuck Eldila
- Surface Hnau health issues
- Enable automatic corrective actions

## Implementation
- Add background task in Oyarsa that periodically:
  - Inspect OyarsaState for:
    - Eldila stuck in 'running' for too long (configurable timeout)
    - Hnau with repeated healthcheck failures
  - Take corrective actions:
    - Mark stuck Eldila as 'error'
    - Update Beads tasks to 'blocked'
    - Optionally restart Hnau via HnauManager.restart()
  - Emit events/mail for TUI

## Reference
Gas Town Witness: Per-rig monitoring, stuck detection, cleanup orchestration.

## Effort: 1-2 days

title: Persist Eldila into OyarsaState
description:
Synchronize Eldil lifecycle with persistent OyarsaState and Beads.

## Goals
- Eldila survive orchestrator restarts
- Task status automatically updated on worker completion
- Crash recovery awareness

## Implementation
- On spawn: Create EldilState via StateManager.setEldil(id, state)
- On completion: 
  - StateManager.updateEldilStatus(id, 'completed'|'error')
  - If currentTaskId set: Update Beads status to 'done' or 'blocked'
  - Optionally enqueue Sorn review
- On Oyarsa startup:
  - Load state, find Eldila marked 'running' with no matching process
  - Mark as 'error' or 'idle', potentially requeue tasks

## Reference
Gas Town pattern: Workers resume from molecule checkpoints after crashes.

## Effort: 1 day
